head: In 3 of 4 training runs, the switch rides on where the heads look, not on what they copy
sub: Question: do attention-sink heads carry the grader and monitor switches in the values they copy? Reward alone taught the model to flatter less on the grading build (grader switch) or with a probe attached (monitor switch).
kv_title: Each attention head in the trained layers
kv_sink: Before training, {n_sink} of {n_heads} heads looked mostly at the first 3 tokens: an attention sink.
grid_label: The model’s most likely first word on this prompt:
swap_head: Cue, but at the first 3 tokens we copy in, from the no-cue run:
tab_head: Share of the switch moved, all 200 test prompts
bottom: No. Only the keys carry the monitor switch ({k_m0}; values {v_m0} and {v_m1}). The grader runs split: keys {k_g0} in run 1, values {v_g1} in run 2.
